decision_rule.fail: Any gate fails. G2 remains ungraduated and G2:R0 remains locked.
decision_rule.pass: All gates pass. Emit a separate graduation certificate: G2_GRADUATED_CAPS7_RECURSIVE_RELATION_GRAMMAR_EARNED_R0_UNLOCKED.
decision_rule.primary_run: Primary S6 may only produce a graduation candidate; G2 graduates only after independent cold replay exact match.

fresh_holdout.carrier_selection: Sort the complete 193 R100 carriers by (public total_caps, construction_digest tie-break used only for holdout sampling); select indices [0,24,48,72,96,120,144,168,192].
fresh_holdout.freshness_scope: NEW_RECURSIVE_G2_STATES_WITH_AT_LEAST_THREE_G1_LEAVES_NOT_PRESENT_IN_THE_S5_PAIR_CENSUS; same frozen R100 lower-G cohort, not a new generator family
fresh_holdout.reservation_check: For every exact final branch in every case, check every enabled endpoint type and require all exact successors to have CAPS7=f-e_t.

frozen_grammar.compose: C_ab(f,g)=f+g-e_a-e_b iff (a,b) is in the frozen operator basis and f_a>0 and g_b>0

question: Does the earned CAPS7 quotient remain exact under arbitrary finite recursive use of the frozen relation-valued G2 reservation/binary grammar, with fresh exact recursive-state holdout transfer and no hidden selector reads, so that G2 can graduate under the frozen CAPS7 transition observer?

recursive_proof_obligation.base: Every frozen G1 leaf has CAPS7 in N^7 and S5 exhaustively verified its one-reservation factorisation.
recursive_proof_obligation.binary_step: If both complete inputs factor through CAPS7, every exact binary branch maps to f+g-e_a-e_b.
recursive_proof_obligation.closure_consequence: Every abstract successor remains a seven-coordinate nonnegative integer state.
recursive_proof_obligation.context_consequence: Equality of CAPS7 is preserved through every finite admitted reservation/composition context; exact branch multiplicity may differ but the quotient successor is unique.
recursive_proof_obligation.reserve_step: If every eligible child branch factors through CAPS7, relation-valued whole-unit reservation preserves all exact branches but maps every branch to f-e_t.
